shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g '.agents/skills/gravity-ui/**' -g '*config*'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,85p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx"

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Checkbox Switch Avatar Text ThemeProvider && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && rg -n -C 3 'navigation|i18n' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg --files -g '*lock*' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'! .git'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -fsSL https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt -o /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.md && rg -n '"'^#|File|file input|--g-text-input|--g-color-base-success'"' /tmp/gravity-uikit-docs.md | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/navigation@3 peerDependencies && npm view @gravity-ui/icons version && npm view @gravity-ui/i18n version'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/navigation@3.11.1 @gravity-ui/icons@2.23.1 @gravity-ui/i18n@1.8.0 @bem-react/classname@1.6.0'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import {writeFileSync} from \"node:fs\"; for (const [name,url] of [[\"uikit\",\"https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt\"],[\"icons\",\"https://gravity-ui.com/icons\"]]) {const r=await fetch(url); const t=await r.text(); writeFileSync("'`/tmp/gravity-${name}.txt`,t); console.log(name,r.status,t.length)}'"'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/i18n/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation | rg 'AsideHeader.*(md|d.ts)"'$|types.d.ts$|INDEX.md'"' && rg -n 'TextInput|Select|Checkbox|Switch|Avatar|Button|theming|upload' /tmp/gravity-uikit.txt"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'base-background|base-float|base-generic|brand|selection|line-generic|spacing' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -150 && node --input-type=module -e 'import {readFileSync} from \"node:fs\";const t=readFileSync(\"/tmp/gravity-icons.txt\",\"utf8\");for(const term of [\"Person\",\"Shield\",\"Bell\",\"ArrowUpFromLine\",\"Globe\",\"CircleQuestion\",\"ChevronRight\",\"Check\",\"Gear\",\"Envelope\",\"Lock\",\"ChevronDown\"]) {console.log(term,[...new Set((t.match(new RegExp("'`.{0,45}${term}.{0,60}`,"g"))||[]).slice(0,4))].join("'"\\n\"))}'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/AvatarImage.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/common.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -100 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'import {readFileSync} from \"node:fs\"; const t=readFileSync(\"/tmp/gravity-icons.txt\",\"utf8\"); console.log([...new Set(t.match(/(?:person|shield|bell|arrow-up-from-line|globe|circle-question|chevron-right|check|gear|envelope|lock|chevron-down)[a-z-]*/g))].join(\"\\n\"));for(const p of [\"navigation\",\"icons\",\"i18n\"]) console.log(p,JSON.parse(readFileSync("'`node_modules/@gravity-ui/${p}/package.json`)).version)'"' && rg -n -- '--gn-|--g-' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -50 && rg -n -- '--g-text-input|--g-textinput' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.css | head -20 && cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | rg '/(person|shield|bell|arrow-up-from-line|globe|circle-question|chevron-right|check|gear|envelope|lock|chevron-down|arrow-right-from-square|circle-check|sliders|house|layout-cells|arrow-up-right)\\.' | head -40 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation | rg '\\.css"'$'"' | head -20 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/components/FirstPanel.js | head -120 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json | head -65"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm && rg -o -- '--gn-[a-z-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.js | sort -u | head -65 && rg -n 'function FirstPanel|function AsideHeader|function Header' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.js | head -15 && rg -n 'Person|ShieldCheck|ArrowUpFromLine|CircleQuestion|ChevronRight|Gear|Envelope|Lock|ChevronDown|Bell|Globe' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -o -- '--gn-[a-z-]+' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index-*.js | sed 's/.*:--/--/' | sort -u | head -75 && rg -n 'function FirstPanel|const FirstPanel|function Header|const Header|function AsideHeader|const AsideHeader' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index-*.js | head -15 && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '4586,4635p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index-CVOBofNk.js && sed -n '1959,1995p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index-CVOBofNk.js && rg -n 'expanded.*240|size:|ASIDE_HEADER' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index-CVOBofNk.js | head -18"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/CompositeBar/Item/Item.d.ts && rg -n -- '--g-avatar-size|--g-avatar-text-font-size' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar && node --input-type=module -e 'import{readFileSync}from\"node:fs\";const t=readFileSync(\"node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index-CVOBofNk.js\",\"utf8\"); for(const re of [/\\.gn-aside-header__header["'^{}]*'"\\{["'^}]*'"\\}/g,/\\.gn-logo["'^{}]*'"\\{["'^}]*'"\\}/g])console.log(t.match(re)?.slice(0,12).join(\"\\n\"));'"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && node --input-type=module -e 'import{readFileSync}from\"node:fs\";const t=readFileSync(\"node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index-CVOBofNk.js\",\"utf8\");console.log(t.match(/\\.gn-aside-header["'^{}]*'"\\{["'^}]*min-width[''^}]*'"\\}/g)?.slice(0,8).join(\"\\n\"));' && rg -n -- '--g-text-body-font-family|--g-font-family-sans' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -5 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarText/AvatarText.css | head -40"
